segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Okay, I think everyone is here. Let's start, we have about ten minutes for the pricing review.

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: Morning. I have the numbers from last quarter ready if we need them.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Good. The main question today is the Starter plan price.

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: Right now Starter is 399 rupees a month and the margin on it is thin.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: From the product side, usage on Starter went up almost forty percent since August.

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: And sales keeps hearing that 399 feels cheap compared to what people get.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: So what are the options on the table?

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: I modelled three: 449, 499 and 549 rupees a month.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: 549 worries me. We might lose the small shops that signed up this year.

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: I agree, 549 is a jump. 499 is easier to explain to customers.

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: At 499 we cover the support cost per account with a small buffer.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Any objection to 499?

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: No objection from me if existing customers get some notice.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Then let's settle it: Starter goes to 499 rupees a month, starting 1 December.

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: Works for me. Existing customers keep 399 until their renewal date.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Yes, renewals move to the new price, not mid-cycle.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: While we are here, I want to bring up the free trial length.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: Some people asked for a thirty day trial instead of fourteen days.

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: Thirty days doubles our trial infrastructure cost. I would not do that now.

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: Most conversions happen in the first week anyway, the data shows that.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Then we keep the free trial at fourteen days. No change there.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: Fine, I will tell the people who asked.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: One more idea. What if we give twenty percent off for annual plans?

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: That needs a proper model first. Twenty percent is a lot on a thin margin.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Let's park the annual discount for now, not deciding anything on it today.

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: Okay. Then I need to update the price sheet that the sales team uses.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Kabir, can you send the revised price sheet to sales by Friday?

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: Yes, I will send the revised sheet by Friday.

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: Also remember the board review is on 20 November, they will ask about this.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Noted, but that is a separate deck, not the price sheet.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: What about the website? The pricing page still says 399.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Someone has to update the website pricing page by next Monday.

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: Not me, I am on the road next week.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: My team is full too. Let's see who is free.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Okay, we will find someone, but it has to be done by next Monday.

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: One thing I want to look at is GST on the new price.

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: I will check the GST impact of 499 and share a note.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Thanks Tanvi. Any date for that?

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: Not sure yet, depends on the accountant, I will share when I have it.

segments.speaker: Kabir Sethi
segments.text: Should we also email the existing customers about the change?

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Let's first get the price sheet and website done, then we talk about emails.

segments.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
segments.text: Makes sense. I have nothing else.

segments.speaker: Tanvi Rao
segments.text: Nothing from my side.

segments.speaker: Meera Iyer
segments.text: Great, thanks everyone. Talk soon.

decisions.fact: The Starter plan price rises to 499 rupees a month from 1 December.
The free trial stays at 14 days.

action_items.fact: Kabir sends the revised price sheet to sales.
The website pricing page is updated to the new price; nobody named.
Tanvi checks the GST impact of the new price and shares a note.

distractors.fact: A 20% discount on annual plans was suggested and parked.
The board review on 20 November is not the price sheet's due date.
